scientific_question: Across randomized spatial BAM/reachability worlds, under which landscape conditions do the original EOG phenomena become common, rare, or observationally ambiguous?

environment.high_autocorrelation: same seeded iid field followed by four fixed rook-neighbour averaging passes with self weight 1
environment.A_viability: abs(environment - median(environment)) <= empirical 70th percentile absolute deviation

B_permissibility.construction: independent seeded node field; exclude the highest 10 percent as antagonistic/nonpermissive
B_permissibility.role: fixed nuisance biotic holes; not a scored factor

geographic_graph.queen: orthogonal plus diagonal adjacent grid cells

world_generation.environmental_edge_rule: edge allowed only when absolute environmental difference <= empirical 70th percentile of differences over the full geographic-edge set
world_generation.barrier_rule: each undirected geographic edge independently blocked with the preregistered barrier-density probability using the replicate RNG
world_generation.source: one uniformly sampled A-and-B permissive node from the largest geographically connected permissive component before environmental/barrier edge filtering
world_generation.truth_graph: geographic adjacency AND endpoint A/B permissibility AND environmental-edge continuity AND barrier-open state

primary_metrics: fraction of A/B-permissive nodes that are unreachable from truth source
fraction of endpoint-environment-similar geographically reachable targets blocked only after pathwise environmental continuity is enforced
number and fraction of single-node critical stepping stones whose removal reduces the truth reachable set
fraction of truth-reachable targets robust to every single non-source node knockout
static source-history alias count: number of nodes in the final truth component that would generate the same unlimited undirected reachable component
temporal source-history contraction after fixed early-positive constraints derived from truth BFS depths
minimal-rescue category for each truth-unreachable A/B-permissive target

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Within each autocorrelation x neighbourhood stratum, mean viable-unreachable fraction is nondecreasing from barrier density 0.05 to 0.20 to 0.35, with a strictly larger pooled mean at 0.35 than 0.05.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if monotonicity fails in any stratum or the pooled endpoint contrast is nonpositive.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Pooled endpoint-similar/pathwise-blocked fraction is larger under low than high environmental autocorrelation.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the pooled mean difference low-high is <=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Pooled critical-stepping-stone fraction is larger under rook than queen neighbourhoods.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if rook-queen mean difference is <=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Pooled fraction of reachable targets robust to every single-node knockout is larger under queen than rook neighbourhoods.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if queen-rook mean difference is <=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Median static source-history alias count is >1 across the full randomized panel.
Among replicates with static alias count >1 and at least one usable early-positive temporal constraint, median temporal contraction fraction is >0.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if median contraction <=0 or no eligible replicates exist.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across the frozen panel, at least one unreachable target occurs in each of barrier_only, environment_only, and both_barrier_and_environment minimal-rescue categories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED for any missing required category; do not add worlds or alter thresholds.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every replicate, removing one or more constraints can only expand the reachable set; no relaxation may create a new unreachable node.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure and stops interpretation.

temporal_constraint_rule.candidate_source_hypotheses: every node in the truth final reachable component
temporal_constraint_rule.early_positive_nodes: up to the lexicographically first three truth nodes at BFS depth 1, 2 and 3, one per available depth
temporal_constraint_rule.candidate_source_compatibility: candidate BFS distance to each early-positive node must be <= its truth BFS depth

claim_boundary: Randomized frequencies describe the frozen synthetic generator, not nature.
Barrier density and autocorrelation are experimental factors, not fitted ecological parameters.
Static source alias count in an undirected connected component is a history-identifiability diagnostic, not ancestry inference.
Minimal rescue class is a mechanistic counterfactual within the generator, not a management recommendation.
stop_rules: Do not change factorial levels after scoring.
Do not alter the 70 percent viability or environmental-edge quantiles after scoring.
Do not increase replicate count after seeing marginal hypotheses.
Do not add a rescue category after seeing results.
